allow: PowerShell($get = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8080/" -Method GET -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "GET Status: $\($get.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host "Content snippet: $\($get.Content.Substring\(0,120\)\)")

PowerShell($body = "message=%D7%A9%D7%9C%D7%95%D7%9D+%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%AA"; $post = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8080/" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "POST Status: $\($post.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host "Response body: $\($post.Content\)")
